name: parcelflow
title: ParcelFlow
description: Cloud ELT pipeline + parcel volume forecasting — Python, SQL, PostgreSQL, Azure Blob, SARIMA, Streamlit
highlights: Idempotent ELT pipeline ingesting 695K synthetic shipment rows across 731 daily partitions and 15 hubs into a star-schema warehouse.
14-day SARIMA forecaster that beat a seasonal-naive baseline by ~16% MAPE (14.1% vs 16.8%).
Data-quality stage quarantining 16,081 bad rows (2.3%) with reasons, plus a run log for observability.

name: damagescan
title: DamageScan
tagline: Parcel damage detection with CNN transfer learning
description: Parcel damage detection — PyTorch transfer learning, Grad-CAM, ONNX, FastAPI
highlights: End-to-end parcel-damage image classifier with PyTorch transfer learning (ResNet-18 vs MobileNetV3) — 93% test accuracy, 1.00 precision on damaged parcels.
FastAPI + ONNX /predict endpoint and a Gradio demo, with Grad-CAM heatmaps confirming the model attends to the parcel, not the background.
Reproducible pipeline: stratified splits, deterministic cuDNN, 7 automated tests, GitHub Actions CI (ruff + pytest), packaged in Docker.

name: docutrack-ai
title: DocuTrack AI
tagline: RAG assistant for shipping & customs documents
description: RAG assistant for shipping & customs documents — LangChain, FAISS, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Streamlit
highlights: Retrieval-augmented Q&A service (FastAPI, FAISS, sentence-transformers) over shipping & customs docs.
LLM invoice-extraction endpoint parsing commercial-invoice PDFs into structured fields.
Anti-hallucination confidence guard with a switchable LLM backend (Gemini).

name: shipsense
title: ShipSense
tagline: Parcel delivery ETA prediction & route optimization
description: Parcel delivery ETA prediction & route optimization — Spring Boot, FastAPI, scikit-learn, React, PostgreSQL, Docker
highlights: Layered Spring Boot API (controller/service/repository, JPA, global error handling).
Python ETL + scikit-learn training pipeline (50k synthetic rows → 49k cleaned) for ETA prediction.
Dijkstra-based route optimization with a React + TypeScript frontend, containerized with Docker.
